children: announced on Thursday that it is expanding its digital asset infrastructure.
, the clients of IBM Digital Asset Haven can now connect to permissioned blockchain networks, including Swift’s blockchain-based shared ledger, through a new beta capability.
The new beta integration allows institutions to instruct tokenized deposit transactions using standard ISO 20022 messaging rather than adopting separate blockchain-specific workflows.

Swift connects more than 12.5K financial institutions across 200+ markets. Its shared ledger is being piloted by 17 first-mover institutions for tokenized deposit transactions, with IBM among the infrastructure providers supporting the initiative.

IBM is also testing an on-premises version of Digital Asset Haven, allowing regulated organizations to manage assets such as stablecoins and tokenized deposits within their data centers on IBM Z and IBM LinuxONE, without relying on public cloud infrastructure.
The moves strengthen the company's push into digital asset infrastructure as banks modernize payment systems and explore tokenized deposits and other blockchain-based transactions.

title: IBM expands digital asset push with Swift blockchain integration
